title: Switch windows of the same app instantly
author: akamienski
summary: Window Hopper always shows its overlay on the first cycle command, so an optional instant-switch mode has a clear implementation seam and measurable behavior.

evidence: The reporter wants same-application switching without displaying the window list.
AltWindowCycle::Switcher::OnHotkey calls BeginCycle and shows the overlay for the first hotkey.
Commit activates the selected HWND when required modifiers are released.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a design for an opt-in instant-cycle mode covering activation timing, wrap order, one-window behavior, and preserved default overlay behavior.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper always shows its overlay on the first cycle command, so an optional instant-switch mode has a clear implementation seam and measurable behavior.
known_information: Window Hopper currently enumerates windows belonging to the foreground application.
The first cycle action selects the next or previous candidate and shows the overlay.
The request explicitly prefers macOS-like immediate cycling with no popup.
inferences: An opt-in mode could likely commit the selected window directly on invocation while retaining the current overlay mode as the default.
issue_context.analysis: The product choice is small and testable rather than an open-ended feature. A full design should decide whether repeated hotkeys continue cycling after focus changes and how modifier release interacts with immediate activation.
initial_investigation: Existing unit tests cover BeginCycle, wrapping, and candidate filtering.
